text_en: Now when all the kings who were beyond the Jordan in the hill country and in the lowland all along the coast of the Great Sea toward Lebanon—the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites—heard of this,
text_cn: 约但河西，住在山地和平原，并沿大海一带直到黎巴嫩山的众王子，即赫特人、阿摩黎人、客纳罕人、培黎齐人、希威人和耶步斯人，听见了这些事，

text_en: they gathered together with one accord to fight Joshua and Israel.
text_cn: 就联合起来，同心协力对抗若苏厄和以色列人。

text_en: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,
text_cn: 基贝红居民，听说若苏厄对耶里哥和哈依所行的事，

text_en: they on their part acted with cunning: they went and prepared provisions, and took worn-out sacks for their donkeys, and wineskins, worn-out and torn and mended,
text_cn: 便设诡计带着行粮上路，将一些旧布袋和破裂缝补的旧酒囊驮在驴上；

text_en: with worn-out, patched sandals on their feet, and worn-out clothes; and all their provisions were dry and moldy.
text_cn: 脚上穿着补过的破鞋，身上穿着褴褛的衣服；所带的食物，又干又碎，

text_en: They went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal, and said to him and to the Israelites, “We have come from a far country; so now make a treaty with us. ”
text_cn: 来到基耳加耳营中见若苏厄；对他和以色列人说：“我们是远方来的，现在请你们与我们立约。”

text_en: But the Israelites said to the Hivites, “Perhaps you live among us; then how can we make a treaty with you? ”
text_cn: 以色列对这些希威人说：“你们也许是我们附近的居民，我们怎能同你们立约？”

text_en: They said to Joshua, “We are your servants. ” And Joshua said to them, “Who are you? And where do you come from? ”
text_cn: 他们回答若苏厄说：“我们是你的仆人。”若苏厄问他们说：“你们是什么人？是从哪里来的？”

text_en: They said to him, “Your servants have come from a very far country, because of the name of the Lord your God; for we have heard a report of him, of all that he did in Egypt,
text_cn: 他们答说：“你的仆人们是因为听了上主你们天主的名声，由极远的地方来的，因为我们听见人谈及他的声望，和他在埃及所行的一切，

text_en: and of all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, King Sihon of Heshbon, and King Og of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth.
text_cn: 以及他对住在约但河东的两个阿摩黎王：即赫市朋王息红和阿市塔洛特的巴商王敖格所行的一切。

text_en: So our elders and all the inhabitants of our country said to us, ‘Take provisions in your hand for the journey; go to meet them, and say to them, “We are your servants; come now, make a treaty with us. ”’
text_cn: 为此，我们的长老和我们本地的居民，对我们说：你们手中带些路上用的食物，去迎接以色列人；对他们说：我们是你们的仆人，现在请你们与我们立约。

text_en: Here is our bread; it was still warm when we took it from our houses as our food for the journey, on the day we set out to come to you, but now, see, it is dry and moldy;
text_cn: 看这就是我们的食物，我们从家中带出来，要到你们这里来的那天还热，看，现在又干又碎；

text_en: these wineskins were new when we filled them, and see, they are burst; and these garments and sandals of ours are worn out from the very long journey. ”
text_cn: 这就是我们的酒囊，才盛酒的时候还新，看，现在都破裂了；这是我们的衣服和鞋，为了路途遥远，都穿烂了。”

text_en: So the leaders partook of their provisions, and did not ask direction from the Lord .
text_cn: 以色列的首领便取了些他们的行粮，并没有请求上主的谕示；

text_en: And Joshua made peace with them, guaranteeing their lives by a treaty; and the leaders of the congregation swore an oath to them.
text_cn: 若苏厄便与他们修好，与他们立了约，让他们生存，会众的首领也向他们起了誓。

text_en: But when three days had passed after they had made a treaty with them, they heard that they were their neighbors and were living among them.
text_cn: 但是，与他们立约后过了三天，以色列人就听说，他们是住在自己附近的居民。

text_en: So the Israelites set out and reached their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-jearim.
text_cn: 以色列子民于是动身，第三天便到了他们的城市：就是基贝红、革非辣、贝洛特和克黎雅特耶阿陵。

text_en: But the Israelites did not attack them, because the leaders of the congregation had sworn to them by the Lord , the God of Israel. Then all the congregation murmured against the leaders.
text_cn: 但以色列子民没有击杀他们，因为会众的首领指着上主，以色列的天主，对他们起过誓；但全会众都对他们的首领不满。

text_en: But all the leaders said to all the congregation, “We have sworn to them by the Lord , the God of Israel, and now we must not touch them.
text_cn: 众首领对全会众说：“我们既已指着上主以色列的天主对他们起誓，那么我们决不能加害他们，

text_en: This is what we will do to them: We will let them live, so that wrath may not come upon us, because of the oath that we swore to them. ”
text_cn: 只有这样作：就是让他们生存下去，免得因我们对他们所起的誓，为我们招来上主的义怒。”

text_en: The leaders said to them, “Let them live. ” So they became hewers of wood and drawers of water for all the congregation, as the leaders had decided concerning them.
text_cn: 首领又对民众说：“让他们生存下去，但他们应为全会众劈柴挑水。”全会众便遵照首领的话而行。

text_en: Joshua summoned them, and said to them, “Why did you deceive us, saying, ‘We are very far from you, ’ while in fact you are living among us?
text_cn: 若苏厄将基贝红人召来，对他们说：“你们为什么欺骗我们说：我们离你们很远，其实你们就住在我们附近？

text_en: Now therefore you are cursed, and some of you shall always be slaves, hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God. ”
text_cn: 从此你们应受诅咒，你们中间，决不断要有人在我天主的殿内，做劈柴挑水的劳役。”

text_en: They answered Joshua, “Because it was told to your servants for a certainty that the Lord your God had commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land before you; so we were in great fear for our lives because of you, and did this thing.
text_cn: 他们回答若苏厄说：“你的仆人们确实听说：上主你的天主，曾吩咐他的仆人梅瑟，要把这整块土地赐给你们，并在你们面前，将这地方上的一切居民消灭；我们见你们前来，我们实在为我们的生命担忧，所以才做了这事。

text_en: And now we are in your hand: do as it seems good and right in your sight to do to us. ”
text_cn: 现在，我们都在你手里，你以为怎样好，怎样对，就怎样对待我们吧！”

text_en: This is what he did for them: he saved them from the Israelites; and they did not kill them.
text_cn: 若苏厄就这样对待了他们：将他们由以色列人手中救出，不让人加害他们。

text_en: But on that day Joshua made them hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation and for the altar of the Lord , to continue to this day, in the place that he should choose.
text_cn: 当天就派定他们在上主选定的地方，为会众，为上主的祭坛，劈柴挑水，直到今日。
